decisive_items: using serial doses of nonionic iodinated contrast (Iopromide) totaling 3 mL/kg over 30 minutes
Approximately 12 hours after the procedure, the patient developed clonic movements of the left upper limb and persistent sucking motions
slight diffuse increase in cortical density predominantly in the right frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes
response.rationale: The temporal link to contrast administration, focal seizures, and diffuse cortical hyperdensity on noncontrast CT are characteristic of contrast-induced encephalopathy rather than hypoxic-ischemic injury.

rejected.why: Although cyanosis and cardiorespiratory arrest are present, the CT finding of cortical hyperdensity without edema or mass effect and the onset 12 hours after contrast administration favor contrast-induced encephalopathy over hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy.
